text:
Priya (CS): Heads up from three recent pilots (Arcadia, Tabletop, Meridian): recurring asks around: better per-route cost visibility, webhook delivery SLA/metrics, and a lightweight model-fallback API. putting here so product can triage before renewals.

Omar (CS): Arcadia called out finance as the holdup. quote: "we need a breakdown by feature route or we can't map to product budgets." they asked CSVs + CSV schedule.

Dev (PM): thanks. exact quotes help. can you paste the Arcadia wording?

Priya (CS): Arcadia: "we're seeing too many dev/test calls included in prod invoices; need per-route tags or per-route export so we can allocate costs." Tabletop wants a simple checkbox in console to exclude certain routes from billing.

Nora (Onboarding): Meridian is in week 2 pilot, renewal check in 5w. they're sensitive to nightly spikes; asked for routing fallback to smaller models overnight. small change could keep them from renewing.

Sam (Eng): for webhook durability: are these timeouts or buffer drops? example they sent: `{"endpoint":"https://events.example/recv","timeout_ms":10000}`. they mentioned duplicate callbacks after retries.

Omar (CS): mostly 503s from customer endpoints and our retry queue gets backed up. they want a dashboard metric (queue depth) + documentation on best practices.

Dev (PM): proposal: 1) model-fallback flag (API + toggle) — quick (1wk) 2) webhook queue metric + basic retry improvements — small (2w) 3) per-route billing export + console filter — medium (3-4w). prioritize in that order to reduce immediate renewal risk.

Priya (CS): agree on order. Meridian renewal risk drops if we have fallback toggle demoed.

Nora (Onboarding): I'll include fallback demo in the renewal call and offer a temporary spend cap until feature ships.

Sam (Eng): I'll mock an API param: `fallback_mode: "cost" | "quality"` and a console toggle. quick branch by Friday.

infra-bot: created ticket CS-2104: "per-route billing export" assigned to Dev (PM)

Omar (CS): attaching customer quotes and sample webhook logs to CS-2104. tagging `pilot-renewal` and `billing-visibility`.

Dev (PM): I'll create an epic and wire the three tickets in priority order. please add estimates in the ticket comments.

Priya (CS): action list: Nora to prep renewal outreach, Sam to PR fallback branch, Dev to create epic + tickets, Omar to attach artifacts. 15m sync tomorrow to confirm.

Nora (Onboarding): inviting Meridian and Arcadia CS contacts to the demo.

Sam (Eng): will have a docs stub + swagger param by EOD Thursday.

Omar (CS): 👍 tagging product-roads for visibility.
